_comment: Servers shown in the main menu's Join a Server list. 'address' is the server's public IP or hostname; 'port' defaults to 8910. Anyone can also type an address by hand. Game updates are downloaded from http://<address>:8911 (tools/run_update_server.sh on the server); a server entry can set 'update_port' or a full 'update_url' to change that.
